app.name: PredictRx
app.tagline: A clinician's aid for medication-risk checks
disclaimer: Decision support only. Not a diagnosis. Please consult a qualified clinician.

analysis.step.resolver.title: Match names
analysis.step.resolver.hint: Matches each medicine to its generic name.

analysis.step.clinical_notes.hint: Reads age band, labs and notes, with personal details removed.
analysis.step.drug_interaction.title: Interactions
analysis.step.drug_interaction.hint: Looks up each pair of medicines in the interaction records and drug label text.
analysis.step.advisory.title: Advisory
analysis.step.advisory.hint: Writes the summary from the findings only.
analysis.step.verifier.title: Verifier
analysis.step.verifier.hint: Checks every finding again against the interaction records.

analysis.error.enqueue_failed: The analysis could not be queued. Please try again.

confidence.title: Confidence

trace.title: Agent trace

scan.photo.title: Prescription image

scan.need.file: Choose or take a photo of the prescription.

scan.replay: This image was already uploaded a moment ago, so that earlier scan is being used.
scan.progress.label: Prescription reading progress
scan.hint.queued: The image is in the queue and will be read shortly.
scan.hint.processing: This can take up to a minute. Keep this page open.
scan.hint.preparing: The medicines were read. They are being matched to drug names before you review them.
scan.poll.slow: This is taking longer than expected. The scan may still finish.

scan.error.empty: This file is empty. Choose another image.

scan.error.tooMany: Too many uploads. Please wait a moment and try again.
scan.error.upload: Could not upload the image. Please try again.

review.patient.locked: The patient is fixed because the image was uploaded for this patient.

family.readOnly: Read-only. You cannot change anything here.

family.error: The summary could not be loaded.
twin.home.hint: The what-if simulation works on a finished analysis. Open an analysis result and choose the What-if tab.
twin.simulation.note: Simulation for exploration. It only re-reads the interaction records for the added medicine. It is not a prediction and not medical advice.
twin.picker.title: Add a medicine to test
twin.picker.hint: Choose a medicine to add to this analysis in a simulation. Nothing is saved to the patient's record and the analysis stays as it is.
twin.picker.label: Medicine to test
twin.picker.placeholder: e.g. Aspirin or a brand name
twin.choice.title: Medicine to test
twin.choice.possible: This is a possible match only. Confirm it before you run the simulation.
twin.choice.unreviewed: This brand-to-generic match has not been reviewed by a pharmacist yet.
twin.choice.alreadyIn: {{name}} is already part of this analysis. Choose a different medicine.
twin.empty.title: No simulation shown yet

twin.error.drug_not_found: This medicine is not in the database. Pick a generic name from the suggestions.
twin.error.drug_already_in_run: This medicine is already part of the base analysis.

twin.error.base_run_not_completed: A what-if needs a completed analysis as its base.
twin.error.tooMany: Too many simulations were started. Please wait a moment and try again.
twin.error.notFound: This simulation or analysis was not found.
twin.error.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
twin.error.generic: The simulation could not be run. Nothing was changed. Please try again.
twin.result.title: If {{drug}} is added
twin.compare.changed: The highest recorded severity changes from {{from}} to {{to}}.
twin.compare.unchanged: The highest recorded severity does not change.

twin.added.none: No interaction record was found between {{drug}} and the matched medicines in this analysis. This does not mean the combination is safe.
twin.mgmt.title: Note from the source
twin.mgmt.note: Taken from the interaction record. It informs the doctor's decision. It is not an instruction to start, stop or change a medicine.
twin.norecord.title: Pairs with no interaction record ({{n}})
twin.norecord.hint: No interaction record was found for these pairs. This does not mean the combination is safe.
twin.gaps.hint: These medicines in the base analysis could not be matched to a drug, so the simulation did not check them against the added medicine. Their interactions are unknown.

twin.limit.labs_vitals_not_used: Lab values and vitals do not change any result here.
twin.limit.label_passages_not_searched: Drug label passages were not searched.
twin.limit.unresolved_medications_not_ch: Medicines that could not be matched were not checked.
twin.limit.other: Another limit applies to this simulation.
twin.stale: A snapshot from {{when}}. It is not recalculated. If the interaction data changes, run it again.
twin.base.title: Medicines in the base analysis
twin.history.title: Earlier what-if runs

twin.history.error: The earlier what-if runs could not be loaded.
state.error.title: Something went wrong
crash.title: This screen could not be shown

notfound.title: Page not found
notfound.text: There is no page at this address. Go back to the start and choose from the menu.

trace.tl.note: Each step shows its state, how long it took and a one-line result. Times are the ones recorded for this run; a step that is not timed shows none.
trace.tl.manual: Entered by hand. There was no image, so this step did not apply.
trace.tl.photo_upload.title: Photo upload
trace.tl.photo_upload.hint: The prescription image is stored privately and deleted after the retention period.
trace.tl.photo_upload.done: Prescription image received and stored privately.
trace.tl.ocr.title: Reading the medicines (OCR)
trace.tl.ocr.hint: A vision model reads the medicine names. You confirm every one before the analysis.
trace.tl.ocr.done: {{n}} medicines read from the image and confirmed by you.
trace.tl.resolve.title: Brand → generic names
trace.tl.resolve.hint: Each brand name is matched to its generic name, so safety records can be searched.
trace.tl.resolve.done: {{resolved}} of {{total}} medicines matched to a generic name.
trace.tl.interaction.title: Interaction check
trace.tl.interaction.hint: Reads the notes and labs, then looks up every pair of medicines in the interaction records and label text.

trace.tl.guardrail.hint: Every finding is checked again against the interaction records, and the text is checked for dosing advice.
trace.tl.guardrail.doneNotes: Verified {{verified}} · Unverified {{unverified}} · Conflict {{conflict}}. The guardrail noted {{n}} issue(s); see the Doctor view.

trace.tl.report.hint: The doctor summary and the plain-language patient card are written from the findings only.
trace.tl.report.done: Doctor summary and patient card are ready. Please review the findings.
